title: EEG and hedonic responses to sonic-seasoning soundscapes
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from participants exposed to sonic-seasoning soundscapes (jungle and deconstruct conditions) alongside eyes-open and eyes-closed resting baselines, collected using EMOTIV EPOC X hardware. It includes liking ratings, baseline-state survey items, and stimulus audio files, aiming to examine hedonic responses to soundscapes designed to modulate taste perception. The dataset also provides per-channel and overall signal quality metrics for quality-based screening of EEG data.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with EMOTIV EPOC X hardware (14 EEG channels) with manufacturer bandpass filtering only, no additional software filtering. Recordings included eyes-open and eyes-closed resting baselines followed by ~17 s exposures to jungle and deconstruct soundscapes, presented in a fixed, non-counterbalanced order. Each EDF file also contains continuously logged contact- and EEG-quality channels sampled at 128 Hz. A processed, EEGLAB-ready derivative dataset containing only the 14 EEG channels for the soundscape conditions is also provided.
